references.text: The Lord explains to Moses and Aaron that they shall not lead the people into the promised land because of their disobedience at the waters of Meribah.
Moses is told to go up Mount Abarim to see the land, but he will not be allowed to enter it because he was disobedient at the waters of Meribah.
Moses asks the Lord if he may cross over the Jordan, but the Lord refuses him and says he will only be allowed to see the land from the mountain.
Fulfillment of the prophecy: Moses goes up Mount Nebo and sees all the promised land before he dies, but is not permitted to enter it.
Aaron shall be gathered to his fathers and shall not come into the land the Lord has given to the children of Israel because of their disobedience at the waters of Meribah.
The Epistle to the Hebrews speaks of men of faith who saw the promises from afar and welcomed them, but did not receive them in their earthly lives, just as Moses saw the land without reaching it.
